sql: SELECT m1.start_year, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM (SELECT DISTINCT TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(year, ' ', -1) AS INTEGER) AS start_year FROM Movie WHERE TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(year, ' ', -1) AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL) m1 CROSS JOIN (SELECT TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(year, ' ', -1) AS INTEGER) AS clean_year FROM Movie WHERE TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(year, ' ', -1) AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL) m2 WHERE m2.clean_year >= m1.start_year AND m2.clean_year <= m1.start_year + 9 GROUP BY m1.start_year ORDER BY film_count DESC, m1.start_year ASC LIMIT 1
